title: PBH 102 - Principles of Epidemiology and Health Systems

items.q: Which term is described by “a study that compares the past exposures of cases with those of controls”?
o: Case-control study
Descriptive study
Confounding
Bias
items.s: Case-control study is a study that compares the past exposures of cases with those of controls.

o: restricting the movement of people exposed but not yet ill
a condition in which the body cannot control blood sugar properly
the system that collects and uses data to guide health decisions
